ang: ANG7 — consistency over intensity: small, constant dhikr every day beats a big burst then nothing; the ring makes the small daily count easy to keep
faith: Bukhari 6464 (most beloved deed = most regular and constant even if little) and/or Tirmidhi 3375 (tongue moist with remembrance) — exact wording from offer_brief.md 'Verified Islamic sources'.
notes: Persona-styled first-person confession (no name, no fake stats, no claimed results numbers). The swipe's '500 words = 75%' style stat must NOT be ported. Lo-fi native photo: phone-camera look, night, bedside or kitchen counter, the ring on a hand or on the nightstand showing its lit count.

ang: ANG11 — wudu-ready: wudu five times a day, the ring stays on (IP67 water resistance), so the count never stops between prayers
vc: wudu water hand / ring at sink
faith: optional, only if natural (Quran 62:10 'remember Allah often'); the hook itself is the ritual fact.
notes: IP67 only. Never 'waterproof', 'shower', 'swim'. Show water splashing on the hand at a sink, not submersion. Ritual-fact headline pattern mirrors the swipe (X. Y five times. Your ___ ...) with new words.

ang: ANG5 — the gift for someone new to the deen (revert friend, spouse, parent): one easy daily habit they will wear and use every day
vc: ring in gift box on satin
faith: none required; if used, Quran 13:28 exact wording only. NO Sadaqah Jariyah or reward-to-giver claim.
notes: Swipe's '30,000+ customers' stat and 50%-off are NOT ours: no social-proof numbers; offer = $49.99, free US shipping, 60-day money-back, 1-year tech warranty only. Reveal device = the count display ('5332') instead of a hidden engraving. Gift box is generic and elegant (we have no box photo: keep box unbranded or minimal).

ang: ANG4 — phone-free remembrance: you open the phone for dhikr and the feed takes you; a ring keeps dhikr off the screen
faith: optional Quran 2:152 exact wording in primary text only.
notes: No real app logos, no clickable-looking buttons/badges/close X (Meta rule).

ang: ANG8 — the old tools fail you: beads scatter at one bump, the clicker announces itself; the ring taps silently and pulses at 33
vc: beads vs clicker vs ring bands
notes: Category-level only, no brands. Never show or knock finger counting (it is the Sunnah). Every contrast true.

ang: ANG6/ANG1 — it looks like a normal ring at work, but it is a silent tasbih: dhikr through the meeting and nobody notices
vc: what they think vs what it is meme
faith: optional: Tirmidhi 3375 phrase 'keep your tongue moist' as the payoff line.
notes: Meme beats: 'What my coworkers think this is:' (ordinary ring on a hand at a desk) / 'Vs...' / 'What it actually is:' (thumb taps, count rises, pulse). Text-overlay-led, mostly no speech or one short VO; Muslim creator persona (hijabi woman or bearded man in office). Very visual; 8-12 s.

ang: ANG9 — after salah, tap through 33/33/34 and feel the pulse at 33, 66 and 99 instead of losing your place
faith: Sahih Muslim 596a (SubhanAllah 33, Alhamdulillah 33, Allahu Akbar 34 after every prayer) — exact wording; say what the dhikr is, never that the ring earns reward.
notes: Competitor swipe (Weslamic/iTasbih): never copy its text, box or line 'better companion'. Hand-macro tap demo with the count display readable in the start frames; vibration shown as subtle visual pulse; prayer mat / after-salah setting.

ang: ANG2 — when your mind races on the walk or commute, turn it into istighfar: tap, keep walking, the count keeps up
faith: Quran 13:28 ('by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured') and/or Muslim 2702 (the Prophet sought forgiveness a hundred times a day) — exact wording.
notes: Open on the wrist/hand with the ring (wrist-first frame like the swipe), 'POV: you're overthinking again' style callout in new words; walk in a city street (no driving shots — AI driving risk). Kinetic captions. Avoid mental-health/anxiety cure claims: dhikr brings the heart rest per 13:28; the ring only helps count.
